build_sql: SELECT "Sales Month", "Product Code", "Customer ID", COUNT(*) AS n, SUM("Sales Amount") AS sales_sum, MAX("Specification/Model") AS spec_max, MAX("Minor Category Name") AS minor_max, MAX("Middle Category Name") AS middle_max FROM sheet1 GROUP BY "Sales Month", "Product Code", "Customer ID"

rewritten_queries.Q2: SELECT "Sales Month" AS month, SUM(n) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "Product Code") AS products, ROUND(SUM(sales_sum),2) AS total_sales FROM reuse_candidate GROUP BY "Sales Month" ORDER BY month
rewritten_queries.Q3: SELECT "Sales Month" AS month, "Product Code" AS product_code, MAX(spec_max) AS spec, MAX(minor_max) AS minor_category, MAX(middle_max) AS middle_category, SUM(n) AS txn_count, COUNT(DISTINCT "Customer ID") AS n_customers, ROUND(SUM(sales_sum),2) AS total_sales FROM reuse_candidate GROUP BY "Sales Month", "Product Code" ORDER BY month, total_sales DESC
rewritten_queries.Q4: SELECT "Product Code" AS product_code, "Sales Month" AS month, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM reuse_candidate WHERE n >= 2 GROUP BY "Product Code", "Sales Month"
